property.name: stage_name
property.value: STAGE 0 PROLOGUE

property.name: text
property.value: Use arrow keys or left stick to walk. Press Space or A to jump.

property.name: text
property.value: Jump to reach elevated platforms. You have 6 frames of coyote time at ledge edges.

property.name: text
property.value: Hold jump longer for a higher jump. Release early for a short hop.

property.name: text
property.value: Press Down to crouch. Crouching reduces your hurtbox size.

property.name: text
property.value: Press Z for Short Attack (fists). Press X for Long Attack (stick).

property.name: text
property.value: Short Attack: 0.5 heart damage, fast recovery. Long Attack: 1.0 heart damage, wider reach.

property.name: text
property.value: Notice the hitstop effect on hit. Time briefly slows.

property.name: text
property.value: Try crouching then attacking. The hitbox shifts to hit low targets.

property.name: text
property.value: Walker enemies patrol back and forth. They detect ledge edges automatically.

property.name: text
property.value: When you enter their detection range, Walkers accelerate toward you.

property.name: text
property.value: If a Walker touches you, you lose 0.5 hearts. You become invincible briefly.

property.name: text
property.value: Watch the sprite flash during invincibility. This is damage feedback.

property.name: text
property.value: Flying enemies move along computed paths. The first uses a sine wave trajectory.

property.name: text
property.value: Sine wave: pos.y = origin + A * sin(2*pi*f*t). Amplitude and frequency are TMX properties.

property.name: text
property.value: The second Flying enemy uses a Bezier curve path. Four control points define the trajectory.

property.name: text
property.value: Press F1 to toggle debug view. You can see Bezier control points and sampled path.

property.name: text
property.value: Shooter enemies fire projectiles when you enter range. Angle computed with atan2.

property.name: text
property.value: angle = atan2(dy, dx) from shooter to player. This is Unit II vector math.

property.name: text
property.value: The gap ahead has a one-way platform. Jump up through it; fall back down.

property.name: text
property.value: Crouch to avoid projectiles that fly high. Time movement between shots.

property.name: text
property.value: The HUD shows health (hearts) and the stage timer. Portrait is the player avatar.

property.name: text
property.value: The red Walker deals 1.0 heart damage. Heavy damage enemies are marked differently.

property.name: text
property.value: If health reaches 0, Game Over appears. You can continue from the last checkpoint.

property.name: text
property.value: The spike floor deals 0.25 heart damage per tick. This is the Light damage tier.

property.name: text
property.value: You have demonstrated all framework systems. Walk right to complete Stage 0.

property.name: text
property.value: Your stages (1, 2, 3) build on everything shown here. Study the source code.

property.name: text
property.value: Step through the arch to proceed. Good luck.
